gaps.lead: Selling the boat was a big mistake.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle expresses regret about a past action.

gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.lead: Everyone thought the concert was excellent.
gaps.explanation: 'Everyone thought it excellent' → 'made an excellent impression on everyone'.

gaps.lead: They won't allow you to enter without a ticket.
gaps.sentence: You ___ to enter without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: 'They won't allow you' becomes 'you won't be allowed'.

gaps.lead: I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: The match officials postponed the fixture because of the storm.
gaps.sentence: The fixture ___ because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Postpone' = 'put off'; in the passive: the fixture was put off.
